acceptance: The Velox image builds for linux/amd64
The container starts the Spark Connect server and BenchBox imports inside it
context: Done in PR #3369. The first full amd64 build failed for a pre-existing reason: the base image's system Python is 3.10.12 and BenchBox has required Python >= 3.11 since 2026-09-13, so `uv pip install --system` could never succeed. The Dockerfile now creates a uv-managed Python 3.12 venv under /opt/venv (uv Python in /opt/uv-python, readable by the spark user), pins pyspark to the image's Spark version from /opt/spark/SPARK_VERSION, and installs BenchBox into it. Verified with `container build --arch amd64` (about 2 minutes): as the spark user `python -c 'import benchbox, pyspark'` prints 0.5.0rc1 4.0.2 (Spark file says 4.0.2); in connect mode with the Gluten plugin the Spark Connect server started on 50051 (the compose healthcheck command passed) and a client ran range(5).count() = 5, `select 1` and `select sum(id) from range(100)` = 4950; the Velox native library loaded under amd64 emulation with no SIGILL. Separate finding filed: every plan falls back to vanilla Spark because Gluten 1.6.0 does not support ANSI mode (velox-gluten-ansi-mode-fallback-20261023).
description: `docker/velox/Dockerfile` now copies `/uv` and `/uvx` from `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.5` instead of running `pip install uv` with the base image's pip. Only the base image plus that uv install was smoke-tested (arm64); the full image is amd64-only and needs the Gluten release tarball, so the complete build, `uv pip install --system "/opt/benchbox[velox]"` and container start-up were not exercised.
